# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public GitHub issue for a suspected security vulnerability.

Report security issues privately to **szalai2003@gmail.com** with the subject `Szalai Automation security`.

Please include, where possible:

- the affected URL or component;
- a concise description of the issue;
- safe reproduction steps;
- the expected security impact;
- any screenshots or proof that do not expose third-party personal data.

Do not perform denial-of-service testing, destructive testing, social engineering, credential attacks, or access data belonging to other users.

The public website is a static site. Its responsible disclosure page is available at `https://gellert4.github.io/WebPage/security.html`, and machine-readable contact metadata is published at `https://gellert4.github.io/WebPage/.well-known/security.txt`.
